Libraries


Reading Files
```{r}
candidates_raw <- read_csv("gerrymandering-YaBoiPasta27/data/g24-candidates-by-district.csv")
results_raw <- read_excel("gerrymandering-YaBoiPasta27/data/g24-results-by-district.xlsx")
precinct_raw <- read_csv("gerrymandering-YaBoiPasta27/data/g24_sov_by_g24_svprec.csv")
census_mapping_raw <- read_csv("gerrymandering-YaBoiPasta27/data/California Congressional Map (1).csv", col_names = FALSE)
head(candidates_raw)
head(results_raw)
head(precinct_raw)
head(census_mapping_raw)
```

Cleaning
```{r}
colnames(candidates_raw) <- tolower(colnames(candidates_raw))
candidates_clean <- candidates_raw |>
    mutate(incumbent = str_detect(name, "\\*"), name = str_remove(name, "\\*")) |>
    filter(district_type != 'ASS') |>
    mutate(district = as.numeric(district)) |>
    mutate(field = case_when(
        field == "CNGDEM01" ~ "house_dem_1",
        field == "CNGDEM02" ~ "house_dem_2",
        field == "CNGREP01" ~ "house_rep_1",
        field == "CNGREP02" ~ "house_rep_2",
        field == "CNGIND01" ~ "house_ind_1",
        field == "SENDEM01" ~ "senate_dem_1",
        field == "SENDEM02" ~ "senate_dem_2",
        field == "SENREP01" ~ "senate_rep_1",
        field == "SENREP02" ~ "senate_rep_2",
        TRUE ~ field  # Keep any other values as-is
    ))
precinct_intermediate <- precinct_raw |> 
    select(
        CDDIST, # Congressional district
        TOTVOTE, # Total votes cast
        SVPREC,
        # Congressional (DEM & REP only)
        CNGDEM01,
        CNGDEM02,
        CNGREP01,
        CNGREP02,
    )
precinct_clean <- precinct_intermediate |>
    mutate(across(CNGDEM01:CNGREP02, as.numeric)) |>
    group_by(CDDIST) |>
    summarize(
        total_votes = sum(TOTVOTE, na.rm = TRUE),
        house_dem_1 = sum(CNGDEM01, na.rm = TRUE),
        house_dem_2 = sum(CNGDEM02, na.rm = TRUE),
        house_rep_1 = sum(CNGREP01, na.rm = TRUE),
        house_rep_2 = sum(CNGREP02, na.rm = TRUE),
        ) |>
    filter(CDDIST != 0) |>
    pivot_longer(
        cols = -c(CDDIST, total_votes),
        names_to = "race_type",
        values_to = "votes"
    )

precinct_clean
```

Combining
```{r}
merged <- precinct_clean |>
    left_join(candidates_clean, by = c("CDDIST" = "district", "race_type" = "field")) |>
    mutate(
    name = case_when(
      race_type == "pres_dem_1" ~ "Kamala Harris",
      race_type == "pres_rep_1" ~ "Donald Trump",
      race_type == "senate_dem_1" ~ "Adam Schiff",
      race_type == "senate_rep_1" ~ "Steve Garvey",
      TRUE ~ name
    ),
    incumbent = case_when(
      race_type %in% c("pres_dem_1", "pres_rep_1") ~ FALSE,
      race_type == "senate_dem_1" ~ TRUE,
      race_type == "senate_rep_1" ~ FALSE,
      TRUE ~ incumbent
    ),
    contest = case_when(
      race_type == "pres_dem_1" ~ "PRSDEM01",
      race_type == "pres_rep_1" ~ "PRSREP01",
      TRUE ~ contest
    ),
    district_type = case_when(
      race_type %in% c("pres_dem_1", "pres_rep_1") ~ "PRES",
      race_type %in% c("senate_dem_1", "senate_rep_1") ~ "SEN",
      TRUE ~ district_type
    )
  ) |>
    select(-c(contest))
print(merged, n = 20)
```

```{r}
precinct <- precinct_raw |> 
    select(
        CDDIST, # Congressional district
        TOTVOTE, # Total votes cast
        SVPREC,
        # Congressional (DEM & REP only)
        CNGDEM01,
        CNGDEM02,
        CNGREP01,
        CNGREP02,
    ) |>
    mutate(across(CNGDEM01:CNGREP02, as.numeric)) |>
    group_by(SVPREC) |>
    summarize(
        total_votes = sum(TOTVOTE, na.rm = TRUE),
        house_dem_1 = sum(CNGDEM01, na.rm = TRUE),
        house_dem_2 = sum(CNGDEM02, na.rm = TRUE),
        house_rep_1 = sum(CNGREP01, na.rm = TRUE),
        house_rep_2 = sum(CNGREP02, na.rm = TRUE),
        ) |>
    pivot_longer(
        cols = -c(SVPREC, total_votes),
        names_to = "race_type",
        values_to = "votes"
    ) |>
  mutate(base_precinct = str_remove(SVPREC, "[A-Z]+$")) |>
  mutate(party = case_when(
    str_detect(race_type, "dem") ~ "house_dem",
    str_detect(race_type, "rep") ~ "house_rep",
    TRUE ~ race_type
  )) |>
  group_by(base_precinct, party) |>
  summarize(
    total_votes = first(total_votes),  # or sum if they differ
    combined_votes = sum(votes),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(base_precinct != "")

precinct
```


```{r}
svprecgeo <- st_read("gerrymandering-YaBoiPasta27/data/shapefiles/srprec_state_g24_v01_shp.shp")
newdistricts <- st_read("gerrymandering-YaBoiPasta27/data/shapefiles/AB604.shp")
newdistricts
```


```{r}
merged_data <- svprecgeo |>
  left_join(precinct, by = c("SRPREC" = "base_precinct")) |>
  select(-c('ELECTION', 'PREC_TYPE', 'FIPS_CODE', 'SRPREC_KEY', 'total_votes'))

newdistricts <- newdistricts |>
  select(c('DISTRICT', 'geometry'))

st_crs(merged_data)
st_crs(newdistricts)
```


```{r}
sr_precincts <- merged_data |>
  st_transform(3310) |>
  st_set_precision(1) |>
  st_make_valid() |>
  st_collection_extract("POLYGON") |>
  mutate(precinct_area = st_area(geometry))

# Step 2: Prepare congressional district data  
districts <- newdistricts |>
  st_transform(3310)|>
  st_make_valid()

# Step 3: Perform spatial intersection
intersections <- st_intersection(sr_precincts, districts)

# Step 4: Calculate area proportions and allocate votes
intersections <- intersections |>
  mutate(
    intersection_area = st_area(geometry),
    area_proportion = as.numeric(intersection_area / precinct_area),
    allocated_votes = combined_votes * area_proportion
  )

# Step 5: Check for any issues
intersections |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  summarize(
    max_proportion = max(area_proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_proportion = min(area_proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
    any_over_1 = any(area_proportion > 1.01, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Step 6: Aggregate votes by district and party
district_votes <- intersections |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  group_by(DISTRICT, party) |>
  summarize(
    total_votes = sum(allocated_votes, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
# View results
print(district_votes)
cat("Allocated total votes:", sum(district_votes$total_votes), "\n")
```

```{r}
original_district_votes <- precinct_clean %>%
    mutate(party = case_when(
        grepl("dem", race_type) ~ "house_dem",
        grepl("rep", race_type) ~ "house_rep",
        TRUE ~ race_type
    )) %>%
    group_by(CDDIST, party) %>%
    summarize(
        original_votes = sum(votes),
        .groups = "drop"
    )

# Identify districts with 0 votes in the new map
districts_with_zeros <- district_votes %>%
    filter(total_votes == 0) %>%
    select(DISTRICT, party)

# Fill in zeros with original data
# Assuming DISTRICT in newdistricts corresponds to CDDIST in precinct_clean
district_votes_filled <- district_votes %>%
    mutate(DISTRICT = as.numeric(DISTRICT)) %>%
    left_join(
        original_district_votes,
        by = c("DISTRICT" = "CDDIST", "party" = "party")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
        total_votes = if_else(
            total_votes == 0 & !is.na(original_votes),
            original_votes,
            total_votes
        )
    ) %>%
    select(-original_votes)

print(district_votes, n = 128)
```
